title: Enhancing Business Central with Address Validation AI
summary: Address validation using Azure OpenAI compares user-entered addresses against existing Business Central address records to identify matches and preserve associated metadata. The solution uses a system prompt to guide AI in matching addresses semantically rather than character-by-character, returning match confidence scores.
key_points: User-entered addresses can be matched to existing Business Central addresses using AI to preserve related data like salesperson details
System prompt design is critical for instructing the AI to ignore abbreviations, street designation variations, and line order while penalizing postal code mismatches
Match confidence scores (0 to 1) help distinguish between high-confidence matches, flagged candidates needing review, and non-matches
AI matching outperforms traditional algorithms like Levenshtein Distance combined with USPS CASS and hard-coded rules
